analysis.reasonEn: Maintained wait-and-see stance for the past 2 sessions. RSI declined from 59.6 to 54.5, continuing sideways movement in the neutral zone. MACD histogram improved from 0.4866 to 0.5511, but the trend reversal signal remains weak. A Higher Low pattern is forming with 5-day low > 20-day low * 1.005, but low volume (0.65x) reduces confidence. The 52-week position at 38.6% remains low. Considering a 1.3x ATR stop loss ($11.04 * 1.3 = $14.35), a sell signal could trigger if the price breaks below $360.75 ($375.23 - $14.35). The target of $384.04 results in a risk-reward ratio below 1.5.
